items.period: Catalogued as Shang oracle-script style; no narrower date is stated. SVG created in 2013.
items.tradition: Oracle-script style; modern Inkscape redraw based on source image J30397.
items.caption: A form catalogued as 巴 in Shang oracle-script style. 巴 is identified as the phonetic component in 吧; this image illustrates a form of that component, not an early form of 吧.
items.alt: A black curved character form on white, with a tall left stroke and hooked strokes extending to the right.
items.selection_reason: It illustrates the graphic tradition of 吧’s phonetic component, while the available evidence does not establish a graphic history for 吧 itself.
items.rights: The Commons page states that the SVG representation is public domain and that attribution is appreciated; it also records source and permission context. Follow the file page’s notes.

limitations.text: The image is a modern redraw, not an ancient artifact image. The form’s identification and 巴’s original referent remain disputed, and no early graphic sequence for 吧 is established.
